about.title: A great tradition returns
about.lead: Belgrade is once again the capital of magic.
paragraphs: The Belgrade Magic Festival is the revival of one of the most important magic events in Serbia.

After seven successful editions, the festival returns in a modern format — an international event that brings together leading Serbian and foreign artists, professional magicians, young talent, families and everyone who loves illusion.

artists.name: Woody Aragón
artists.bio:
Spanish magician and author, best known for his card magic. Penn & Teller have performed his “Ritual of Love” in their Las Vegas show since 2016 and on Fool Us. His creations have also been shown on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, and “Ritual of Love” opens the Netflix series Death by Magic, performed by Drummond Money-Coutts.

His A Book in English won the Magic Academy Award for best magic book (Tannen's, New York, 2012), and in Memorandum he describes his own memorised deck. From 2010 to 2012 he presented the magic segment Hablemos de magia on Cadena SER radio.

artists.name: Den Den
artists.bio:
A master of manipulation from Japan. Den Den turns cards, paper and everyday objects into precise, beautifully choreographed visual poetry, drawing on his experience in traditional Japanese theatre and dance.

In 2014 he was named Magician of the Year by the Academy of Magical Arts and received the Gold Medal Award of Honour from the Society of American Magicians, at the time only the second magician to receive it.

He appeared as The Manipulator in The Illusionists – Witness the Impossible in London's West End, and opened Supermagic in Rome in 2020. He discovered magic at the age of seven.

artists.name: Igor Trifunov
artists.bio:
Igor Trifunov is the most successful Serbian magician and illusionist of the new generation. He has won acclaim at many international competitions, including fourth place at the World Championship of Magic in Rimini, the Grand Prix at the Balkan Magic Congress and first place at the magic competition in Baden.

He created the TV series Ulična Magija (Street Magic), the children’s show Igorov Magični Šou (Igor’s Magic Show), the illusion show Igorov Magični Spektakl (Igor’s Magic Spectacle) and the international spectacle Magični Varijete (Gala Show Variete).

artists.name: Maxim Gladstein
artists.bio:
A professional illusionist and magician from Russia who has lived and worked in Belgrade for many years. He is known for an elegant style and an air of mystery that joins classic magic with modern stage illusion.

He has won awards at magic competitions in France and China. His repertoire runs from close-up sleight of hand with cards, coins and small objects, to large stage illusions with transformations, vanishes and mentalism, to interactive shows for adults and children in which the audience becomes part of the trick.

artists.name: Tamia
artists.bio:
Tamia Dulce Villca Šeme (born 1998) is a Slovenian aerial silks performer, stuntwoman and circus artist. Before the circus she was a member of the Slovenian national rhythmic gymnastics team, and she is a qualified sports coach.

She finished second in the super-final of the eighth season of Slovenija ima talent (2021), and in 2024 won the Croatian Supertalent: a group Golden Buzzer at her audition, then 47.7% of the public vote in the final.

Her acts combine gymnastic discipline with dramatic aerial drops, flexibility and storytelling. She also performs in the duo LaTam_Duo and coaches, helping professional circus arts grow in Slovenia.

artists.name: Elastic
artists.bio:
Stéphane Delvaux, known as Elastic, is one of Europe's most distinctive masters of physical comedy and clowning. His act mixes mime, acrobatics and improbable body movement, somewhere between circus, comedy and theatre, without a single word.

He has appeared on the French television show Le Plus Grand Cabaret du Monde, and his work was recognised at the International Circus Festival of Monte-Carlo.

artists.name: Françoise Rochais
artists.bio:
Françoise Rochais, known on stage as Francesca, is one of the most accomplished jugglers on the international circus scene and a Guinness World Records holder.

She won a silver medal at the Festival Mondial du Cirque de Demain in Paris and a gold medal at the International Juggling Association convention in Las Vegas.

In Belgrade she performs with the Belgian comedian Elastic (Stéphane Delvaux): precise juggling, physical comedy and theatre in one act.

vision.title: Magic belongs to everyone.
paragraphs: The festival is both a major cultural event for the general public and an international professional gathering of magicians from Serbia and abroad.

Our long-term goal is for the Belgrade Magic Festival to become a fixture on the European festival calendar — a meeting place for the world's leading magicians and a must-visit for anyone who loves illusion.

history.title: Seven editions. One big story.
paragraphs: The Belgrade Magic Festival was first held in 2012 to promote and develop the art of magic in Serbia.
Over seven successful editions it has hosted many Serbian artists and international guests from across Europe, and become one of the most important gatherings of magicians in the region.

anthem.text: The official anthem of the Belgrade Magic Festival. Play it while you look through the programme.

items.name: Domenico Dante
items.bio:
An Italian magician and magic dealer since 1984, after fifteen years as a manager and hospital director. President of the Club Magico Italiano from 1990 to 2015 and now its Life Honorary President, he is a member of the Inner Magic Circle with Gold Star, a Lifetime Member of the Magic Castle in Hollywood and a winner of the Murray Award (Blackpool, 2008).

A FISM Qualified Jury Member since 1991, he was President of FISM International from 2012 to 2022 and is now its Honorary President. He has produced or organised more than 120 international conventions. His motto: “Promoting Magic as an Art”.

items.name: Andrea Baioni
items.role: FISM President · friend of the festival
items.bio:
Andrea Baioni joined the Club Magico Italiano in 1977, was teaching magic by 1983 and in 2008 founded the Italian Team of Magic. Since 1986 he has worked as a professional performer, comedian, master of ceremonies and show producer, including corporate events for Ferrari, FIAT, Volvo and Ferrero. He has written hundreds of articles for Italian magic magazines, and from 1998 to 2021 was a member of The Magic Circle in the United Kingdom, reaching the Inner Magic Circle with Gold Star.

A FISM Official Judge since 2009, he was Vice President (2016–2021) and then President (2021–2024) of FISM Europe. Since 2022 he has been President of FISM International, the federation of 116 magic societies in 51 countries that organises the World Championships of Magic. His library holds more than 4,000 books on magic.

items.name: Lee Alex
items.bio:
British-born, Lee Alex is a professional magician, lecturer and creator of original textile magic. For more than three decades he has performed worldwide as a stage illusionist and magician, and consulted for film, stage, television and advertising productions.

Lee is an official judge for the Fédération Internationale des Sociétés Magiques (FISM), regularly serving on juries at international competitions. His lecture on quick-change magic, “Time for a Change?”, has been presented at the Magic Circle in London, the Magic Castle in Hollywood, the World Magic Seminar in Las Vegas and Jeff McBride's Magic and Mystery School.

items.name: Dani Belev
items.role: FISM judge · founder of the Golden Cat festival
items.bio:
A Bulgarian magician and illusionist from Gabrovo with more than two decades of professional experience. He is president of the Quick Hands Project Magic Club and founder and organiser of the international magic festival Golden Cat in Gabrovo, which brings together magicians and performers from many countries.

His long-standing work has contributed significantly to the art of magic and to international collaboration in the magic community. In 2026 he became the first Bulgarian to qualify as a FISM judge.

items.name: Bojan Barišić
items.role: Jury member · creator of BB Magic
items.bio:
Bojan Barišić is a magic creator and inventor known for exclusive, high-end stage gimmicks made under his brand BB Magic. His creations are sought after by top professional magicians worldwide and are made in limited numbers because of their intricate design and specialised parts.

Among them are Thin Air, a stage gimmick developed over five years for hyper-visual card productions with the fingertips fully visible; Double Production, which produces card fans, silks or banknotes from both empty hands at once; the BB Vanishing Cane 3.0, a modern take on the classic appearing cane endorsed by the legendary Fantasio; and Final Night, his clean-handed solution to the classic Bank Nite plot.

sections.title: Who processes your data
sections.text: Your data is processed by {organiser}, the organiser of the Belgrade Magic Festival. For any questions, write to {contact}.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.text: When you register: first and last name, email, phone if you give it, country, chosen package and add-ons, your notes, and the text and time of your consent. To protect the form from abuse, each submission also stores a one-way hash of your IP address (not the address itself) for up to two days.

sections.title: Do you have to give us this data
sections.text: Your name, email, country and chosen package are needed to process the registration; without them we cannot register you. Phone and notes are optional.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.text: To process your registration, send you a summary and payment details, remind you if payment does not arrive, and organise the festival. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.text: We process registration data to perform the contract for taking part in the festival, i.e. your registration and fee. The consent you give in the form covers storing your data to process the registration. Google Analytics, if we enable it, is used only with your explicit consent.

sections.title: Who else has access
sections.text: Registrations are stored in a Supabase database, and registrations and confirmations are sent by email through Resend. These services process data only on our instructions.

sections.title: Transfers outside Serbia
sections.text: Resend is a US company, and Supabase may store data on servers outside Serbia. Transfers rely on the standard contractual clauses these services apply, in line with the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection and the GDPR.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: Until the festival is over and all obligations are settled, unless the law requires us to keep it longer.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data. Write to {contact} and we will reply within 30 days.

sections.title: Withdrawing consent and complaints
sections.text: You can withdraw your consent at any time by writing to {contact}; this does not affect processing before the withdrawal. If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Serbian Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection (www.poverenik.rs).

sections.title: Cookies and external content
sections.text: Google Analytics loads only if you allow it in the cookie notice. The map comes from OpenStreetMap. A YouTube video, if there is one, loads only when you click it.

cookies.text: We use cookies to measure traffic and improve the site. You can accept or reject them, and the site works the same either way.
